title: feat(triage): let a policy request changes on a pull request
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed

- New Do kind in the pack schema and parser (additive): `request-changes`, with an empty target.
- It resolves to a body listing the failed checks, among the action's own `checks`, that are the author's to fix (`Triage requests changes:` then `- <check>: <reason>`); with none, the step is skipped. The executor posts it as a `REQUEST_CHANGES` review pinned to the verdict's head with a `<!-- corbits-request-changes -->` marker; it is satisfied when the App's marked review on that head stands or was dismissed. Refused once the head moves. The triage comment is unchanged. No extra grant.
- A review is triage's own only when the App's login wrote it with the marker; the App's login is read only when a review carries the marker. Facts ignore triage's own request, so it never blocks the App's approval.
- The verdict carries `changesWanted`. When a settled head leaves every request-changes action's checks nothing to fix, or the pack no longer requests changes while one stands, the automatic mirror (`fixedHead`) dismisses the App's standing requests. A dismissal GitHub refuses is kept in the mirror's result as `changeRequestsKept` and does not fail it. Approving does not dismiss; the App's approval supersedes its own request. A dismissed request no longer reads as an approval of that head.
- Editor, prose and pending Dos list it as "Request changes on the pull request".

## Verification

- `bun run check`
- `bun run test`: 700 pass, 0 fail
- New tests: end to end, failing CI requests changes once and a later head with CI fixed dismisses it, and a refused dismissal is recorded without failing the mirror. Executor idempotency per head, a later approval still posted, head-moved refusal. Triage's own request lets the fixed head approve while another bot's marked request still counts; a pack without request-changes takes back a standing request; a CI-scoped action lists only CI and stops wanting changes once CI is fixed; skipped without author-fixable failures. Schema and parser accept the kind.
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: feat(triage): let a policy request changes on a pull request

files.patch:
@@ -53,7 +53,10 @@ const ACTIONS: Action[] = [
     checks: ["ci", "custom-1"],
     branches: {
       yes: [{ kind: "request-review", target: { to: "role", role: "maintainers" }, automatic: true }],
-      no: [{ kind: "comment", target: { body: "Please fix CI and link a ticket." }, automatic: false }],
+      no: [
+        { kind: "comment", target: { body: "Please fix CI and link a ticket." }, automatic: false },
+        { kind: "request-changes", target: {}, automatic: true },
+      ],
       unsure: [{ kind: "labels", target: { from: "list", labels: ["needs-triage"] }, automatic: true }],
     },
   },
